License swap without exam for citizens of RU, BY, KZ, EU, US. Rent a car the day you receive the ID.

items.q: How is the Investor Visa different from the Golden Visa?
items.a: Investor is a starter visa for 2 years from $204K. Golden is the premium 10-year visa from $545K. Many start with Investor and upgrade to Golden later. Investor is simpler, cheaper and faster, but renews every 2 years.

items.q: Can I obtain the visa without coming to Dubai?
items.a: Up to 80% of the process is remote: shortlist, deal via power of attorney, document collection. You only need to fly in once for 1–2 days for biometrics, medical test and Emirates ID.

items.q: What if I sell the property within 2 years?
items.a: The visa is cancelled. You need to buy another 750K AED+ property to renew. If you're already in the process of upgrading to Golden, you can switch directly to the 10-year version.

items.q: Can I work for a foreign company?
items.a: Yes, a UAE resident can work remotely for any country. You can also open a UAE company (free zone or mainland) and keep operating. Foreign-company salaries are not taxed.

items.q: Does the visa include children over 18?
items.a: Sons under 18 are included automatically. Daughters — any age while unmarried. Sons 18–25 may be included with proof of studies in Dubai. Parents require a separate visa.

items.q: How much does renewal cost after 2 years?
items.a: The government fee is the same ~4,100 AED ($1,115). The condition is that the property is still in your name (750K AED+). If the property has appreciated, you can upgrade directly to the Golden Visa.
Yes. Your equity must be 750K AED+. The mortgage portion does not count towards the visa amount. A bank NOC is required.

items.q: What if I want to switch to Golden before the 2 years are up?
items.a: Any time. Top up to 2M AED equity (a second purchase works), file for Golden and close the Investor Visa. The switch fee is about $1,825.
